texts.preamble: Imran Pasha vs The State Of Telangana on 30 June, 2025 Author: N.Tukaramji Bench: N.Tukaramji The Honourable Sri Justice N.Tukaramji Criminal Petition No. 7992 Of 2025 Order
texts.facts: This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS, 2023') seeking quashment of the proceedings in F.I.R No.130 of 2025 on the file of Ghanpur W Police Station, Warangal District, against the petitioner/accused. 2. The petitioner is arrayed as sole accused in F.I.R No.130 of 2025 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 272 and 275 of BNS. Accordingly, the complainant apprehended the accused Imran Pasha vs The State Of Telangana on 30 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175060756/ 1 and seized 1) tobacco gold packets (07) each worth Rs.500/-, total worth Rs.3500/-, 2)BE 54 tobacco packets (14) Each worth 1.270. total worth Rs 17.780. 3) Black baba tobacco packets (37), each worth Rs.185/-, Total worth Rs.6,845, 4) Jk 3320 tobacco boxes (170), each worth 50/, total worth Rs.8500/, 5) V1-tobacco packets (350), each worth Rs.30/-, total worth 3 NTR,J Rs.10,500/-, 6) RR. Tobacco packets (207) each worth Rs.200/-, total worth Rs.41,400, 7) Miraj tobacco boxes (17) each worth Rs.225/-, total worth Rs.3,825/-, 8) Baba 120 Tobacco packets (37), each worth Rs.450/-, total worth Rs.16,650/-, 9) K3320 tobacco tins (4) each worth Rs.600/-, total worth Rs.2400/-, 10) Baba 120 tobacco tins (10), each worth 790/- total worth Rs.7900/-, 11) Anar tobacco packets (15) each worth Rs.160/-, total worth Rs.2,560/-, 12) M-Gold Tobacco boxes (51) each worth Rs.600/- total worth Rs.30,600/-, 13) Amber tobacco packets (80), each worth Rs.175/-, total worth Rs.14,000/-, 14) Blue bull tobacco packets (31) each worth Rs.200/-, total worth Rs.6200/-, 15) Swagath Gold tobacco packets (08) each worth Rs.156/-, total worth Rs.12,248/-, 16) Chini tobacco packets (06), each worth Rs.270/-, total worth Rs.1620/-, total seized packets is valued at Rs.1,86,528/- by pasting chits before two mediators. 9. It is pertinent to note that the related Notification No.501/FSS/I/2022 dated 07.01.2022, prohibiting manufacturing, storing, distribution, transportation and sale of gutka and pan masala in the entire State of Telangana, has been stayed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Shri Venkateshwara Traders v. State of Telangana and others vide SLA No.20441 of 2021 with SLP(C) No.1656 of 2022. Thereafter, the Director General of Police, Telangana State issued Circular Memorandum in RC.No. 295/R1-NS/2022 with directions to the 4 NTR,J Station House Officers not to interfere with the business activities, who carry out the business as per rules of Food Safety and Standards Authority of India and also not to take any coercive measures against the tobacco traders as long as the order of the Hon'ble Supreme Court is in force.
texts.arguments: 4. The prosecution case in brief is that the petitioner/accused is involved in selling and purchasing the banned Tobacco products and the Police concerned has seized the said Tobacco products worth of Rs.1,86,528/- from the possession of the petitioner. 5. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that a Coordinate Bench of this Court vide Criminal Petition Nos.3731 and Batch on 2 NTR,J considering similar allegations and the merits [LEAKAGE_MASK] the proceedings against the petitioners therein. He further submits that the police have registered the present crime in violation of the orders passed by this Court. Hence, prayed for quashment of the proceedings against the petitioners. 6. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that the petitioner had been found with the Tobacco products and investigation is pending. However fairly admitted that in the authority cited by the petitioner in the similar circumstances, the proceedings against the petitioner therein were [LEAKAGE_MASK]. 10. Having regard to similar factual position, a Coordinate Bench of this Court in Crl.P.No.6235 of 2022 held that against the allegations of illegal sale and transportation of tobacco products the accusations under Sections 188, 269, 270, 272, 273, 278, 328 read with Sections 511, 336, 409 and 420 of I.P.C., cannot be maintained and [LEAKAGE_MASK] the proceedings against the petitioners therein. 11.
